notes.title: New version 0.0.2 Just been added !
notes.content:
New version 0.0.2 Just been added !


New features : 

Now you can play 10 new levels in Anki (so  this mean you have now  69 total levels) plus 10 extra lvls  that you can  discover using crystals .


Crystal backgrounds has been changed

New  Mode  " RANDOM LVLS " ( every time you play the game picks a random level for you )
